Instruction: Generate code that performs the following tasks using the pyaedt library:

1. Creates a temporary folder and prints its path.
2. Downloads an example file into the temporary folder.
3. Sets the non-graphical mode and launches AEDT in graphical mode using SI units.
4. Initializes AEDT and launches HFSS 3D Layout.
5. If the AEDT file already exists, it removes it and saves the project in the temporary folder.
6. Prints the boundaries from the setups object.
7. Hides all nets and then makes only two specified nets visible.
8. Plots the two specified nets.
9. Makes all layers visible.
10. Changes the color of a specified layer.
11. Disables the visibility of components for the top and bottom layers.
12. Fits all so that all can be visualized.
13. Closes the project and releases the desktop.

```python
import os
import tempfile
import shutil

from pyaedt import Desktop, downloads, Hfss3dLayout
from pyaedt.generic.general_methods import check_and_download_file

# 1. Create a temporary folder and print its path.
temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
print("Temporary folder created at:", temp_dir)

# 2. Download an example file into the temporary folder.
example_url = downloads.download_3dlayout_antenna()
example_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, os.path.basename(example_url))
if not os.path.exists(example_file):
    check_and_download_file(example_url, destination_folder=temp_dir)
print("Example file downloaded to:", example_file)

# 3. Set the non-graphical mode and launch AEDT in graphical mode using SI units.
nongraphical = False
new_desktop = Desktop(specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=nongraphical, new_desktop_session=True)

# 4. Initialize AEDT and launch HFSS 3D Layout.
project_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(example_file))[0] + ".aedt"
project_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, project_name)
if os.path.exists(project_path):
    os.remove(project_path)
app = Hfss3dLayout(projectname=project_path, specified_version="2024.1", non_graphical=nongraphical)

# 5. If the AEDT file already exists, it removes it and saves the project in the temporary folder.
app.save_project()

# 6. Print the boundaries from the setups object.
if hasattr(app, "setups") and app.setups:
    print("Boundaries from setups object:")
    for setup in app.setups:
        print(setup.boundaries)
else:
    print("No setups or boundaries found.")

# 7. Hide all nets and then make only two specified nets visible.
all_nets = app.nets.net_names
net1 = all_nets[0] if len(all_nets) > 0 else None
net2 = all_nets[1] if len(all_nets) > 1 else None
if net1 and net2:
    app.nets.hide_all_nets()
    app.nets.show_nets([net1, net2])

    # 8. Plot the two specified nets.
    app.nets.plot([net1, net2])
else:
    print("Not enough nets found to show and plot.")

# 9. Make all layers visible.
app.stackup.show_all_layers()

# 10. Change the color of a specified layer.
layer_names = app.stackup.layers
if layer_names:
    layer_to_color = list(layer_names.keys())[0]
    app.stackup.set_layer_color(layer_to_color, (255, 0, 0))  # Set to red

# 11. Disables the visibility of components for the top and bottom layers.
top_layer = app.stackup.top_layer
bottom_layer = app.stackup.bottom_layer
if top_layer:
    app.stackup.layers[top_layer].components_visible = False
if bottom_layer:
    app.stackup.layers[bottom_layer].components_visible = False

# 12. Fits all so that all can be visualized.
app.modeler.zoom_to_fit()

# 13. Closes the project and releases the desktop.
app.close_project(saveproject=True)
Desktop.ReleaseAll()
shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)
```
